title: Ceramics Large Tea Cup with Loose Leaf Infuser, Spoon and Lid, 16 oz Tall Coffee Mug, Microwave and Dishwasher Safe, Rustic Matte Ceramic Glaze, Tea Strainer (Pink)
description:
About this item
【LARGE TEA MUG】- This mug has a large capacity(16 Oz) with lid, 18/8 stainless steel tea infuser and golden coffee spoon.As a reusable large tea cup, it can bring you the best quality and convenient service for your tea time. Remove the infuser, it is very suitable for milk, cocoa, coffee, cold drinks, cereals, etc. Also suitable for home, office, party, restaurant.
【STAINLESS STEEL INFUSER】- Built-in removable food-grade 304 stainless steel tea infuser for loose teas or blooming teas, and has an ultra-fine strainer that can filter most teas. The tea infuser is made of thick 18/8 stainless steel, which is anti-oxidation, anti-rust, and more durable.
【LEAD FREE ALL NATURAL GLAZE】- The ceramic coffee cup is LEAD-FREE and NON-TOXIC, chip-resistant and sturdy for long use. All our materials are food grade. Gencywe only uses grade A porcelain, which is the highest grade of porcelain, because every other grade is riddled with defects. This coffee cup is Microwave, oven, freezer, and dishwasher safe.
【DUAL-PURPOSE LID & LARGE HANDLE】- The lid will keep your tea or coffee hot, inside of the lid has a groove design, in order to place the infuser more conveniently to avoid confusion. Comfortable handle - Keeps fingers away from hot mug, even with larger hands, the handle is comfortable for you or your husband to be held.
【OUR PLEDGE】- All our products check the highest quality standards, so you can be sure that the tea cup will surpass your expectations. It comes packed with care in a compact box, and it is super user-friendly, saving you time and energy. As a gift for a special person – or yourself!
